title: 撰写生产者盈利范围理论文档
instruction:
您是 Foxhollow Press 的财务经理，负责确定 Hartsmere Supply 的盈利工作范围，Hartsmere Supply 是一家抵押贷款机构，拥有 32 信贷员。贾雷克·埃林森 (Jarek Ellingsen) 想知道在 1 月生产商协议发布之前哪些官员实际上是有利可图的，但他没有透露这一决定是重组薪酬还是关闭博伊西分公司。这些是不可互换的：企业管理费用前的贡献、锁台对冲和回购准备金后的贷款水平利润以及每生产 FTE 的产能成本都可以产生一个站得住脚但不同的答案。安娜·哈钦斯 (Ana Hutchins) 还需要在为此次合作提供的薪酬政策语言范围内，而不是暗示一项经济上有吸引力的计划已获得法律批准。使用`Hartsmere_scope_review_packet.pdf`修改现有草案，其中包含草案、审核意见、变更事实、期间摘要、数据清单、样本记录和适用的政策摘录。源数据具有迁移重复项、格式错误的官员标识符、不一致的状态标签以及不属于资助生产分析的记录。
它还显示了一项有争议的回购规模大到足以推翻官员的明显结果，因此简报不能将这一案例隐藏在常规指导中，并且锁台可能无法提供拟议定义之一所需的贷款级别分配。为 Jarek 和 Ana 制定最终的参与范围和定义简介，说明工作将要回答和不会回答的问题，区分合理的盈利能力定义及其决策用途，指定比较期和数据拉取，处理审查意见和更改的事实，记录未解决的证据的处理或升级，并设置授权的数据拉取和模型构建状态，而不仅仅是建议其他人应该决定什么。仅使用数据包支持的图表和政策语言，尽量减少借款人敏感信息，并将文档最多控制为六页。使用文件名`producer_profitability_scope_brief.docx`将完成的文件写入工作目录的顶层。

---

上述文件位于`references/`中：

- `references/Hartsmere_scope_review_packet.pdf` — 源数据包，包含先前的草案、明确的审查意见、更改的参与事实、两期运营摘要、数据清单和样本记录以及适用于评估的政策文本。
将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `producer_profitability_scope_brief.docx` — 修订了参与范围和定义，简要介绍了决策问题、替代盈利能力定义、比较基础、数据要求、合规边界、例外情况、未解决的数据路径和授权参与状态。 （将文件放置在工作目录的顶层。；准确使用指定的文件名。；不要超过六个渲染页。；仅使用所提供的数据包支持的数字、事实和政策语言。；最大限度地减少借款人敏感信息。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

materials.text:
Hartsmere Supply — Producer Profitability Scope Review Packet
Foxhollow Press financial management | 15 July 2025 | Internal review packet
Purpose. Prior scope, review comments, changed facts, period summaries, data inventory, sample records, and supplied compensation-policy
extracts for the revised engagement brief. Identifiers are synthetic and minimized.
1. Prior draft (excerpt)
“We will rank all 32 loan officers by profitability for January producer agreements. Profitability will be funded-loan revenue less officer compensation
and direct production expense. We assume lock-desk economics can be allocated to each loan and will use the result to identify officers for action.
The Boise branch question can be answered from the same ranking.”
2. Review comments and changed facts
    Reviewer                       Comment / changed fact
    Jarek Ellingsen, principal     Distinguish possible Boise branch closure from compensation restructuring; the decision is not selected.
    Ana Hutchins, counsel          Stay within supplied compensation-policy language. Economics is not policy approval; state the narrow
                                   unforeseen-settlement-cost exception accurately.
    Mina Rao, data owner           Migration created duplicate loan rows and status variants. Some officer IDs are malformed or absent. Lock desk can provide
                                   aggregate P&L; an allocation key is not guaranteed.
    Jarek / counsel                One disputed actual repurchase is large enough to reverse an officer’s apparent result. Show recurring and all-in views.
    Change log                     January agreements issue after analysis; model build may proceed only after decision objective and evidence gates are recorded.

3. Designated comparison periods and summaries
Use economically relevant funded/settlement date. Period A: 1 Jan–31 Mar 2025 (Q1); Period B: 1 Apr–30 Jun 2025 (Q2). These are
completed-period management summaries, not model output.
    Measure                                         Q1 2025                             Q2 2025                              Directional change
    Funded loans / volume                           418 / $112.4m                       463 / $128.7m                        +10.8% loans; +14.5% volume
    Funded-loan revenue / margin                    $1.742m                             $1.963m                              +$0.221m (+12.7%)
    Officer compensation                            $0.842m                             $0.904m                              +$0.062m (+7.4%)
    Direct production expense                       $0.286m                             $0.311m                              +$0.025m (+8.7%)
    Lock-desk hedge result                          ($0.118m)                           ($0.076m)                            +$0.042m less negative
    Routine reserve expense                         $0.091m                             $0.104m                              +$0.013m (+14.3%)
    Actual repurchase events                        $0.228m total; $0.210m disputed     $0.032m                              Q1 includes disputed case
    Producing FTE (period-adjusted)                 29.5                                31.0                                 +1.5 (+5.1%)

Q2 had higher funded count, volume, revenue, direct cost, routine reserve, and producing FTE; hedge loss was less negative. The summaries do not
establish causation. Q2 migration and an April staffing transfer require a bridge before like-for-like officer trends are asserted.
 4. Data inventory and accountable owners
    Domain / source                Required fields and evidence                                                                              Owner / timing
    Loan system (LOS)              Stable loan/business key; source row ID; version/update timestamp; application and                        Mina Rao, Data Ops —
                                   funded/settlement dates; branch; officer ID; status; funded amount; revenue/margin;                       extract as of 30 Jun 2025,
                                   refund/reversal/pricing correction; shared-credit fields                                                  with migration history
    Compensation / payroll         Officer ID and roster crosswalk; base/commission/bonus; employer taxes/benefits if directly               Lena Ortiz, Payroll —
                                   attributable; period and adjustment posting date                                                          Q1/Q2 close plus
                                                                                                                                             adjustment ledger
    Lock desk                      Loan-level hedge gain/loss; allocation key/method; lock ID; aggregate control totals; reconciliation to   Tom Baird, Lock Desk —
                                   desk P&L;                                                                                                 Q1/Q2 final P&L;
                                                                                                                                             allocation support due 8
                                                                                                                                             Aug
    Reserve / repurchase           Reserve rate/charge; reserve release; claim amount/date; case status; recovery; disputed-case             Priya Sen, Quality —
                                   correspondence and final attribution                                                                      ledger through 30 Jun;
                                                                                                                                             counsel confirms dispute
    Roster / capacity              Hire/termination/transfer dates; branch; paid hours/FTE; leave; producing status and productive-time      Lena Ortiz + Jarek —
                                   evidence; capacity cost (salary/benefits/occupancy where assigned)                                        payroll and roster
                                                                                                                                             snapshot
    Privacy filter                 No borrower name, contact, address, government ID, income, or credit fields; stable loan key only         Mina Rao — enforce
                                                                                                                                             before transfer

5. Sample records from the packet
Compact extract showing why normalization and exception logging are required; not a complete population.
    Source row          Loan key                 Officer / status                                 Amount / issue
    LOS-7712            HM-20418                 J-014 / FUNDED                                   $300,000; migration v1
    LOS-8841            HM-20418                 J-014 / Closed-Funded                            $300,000; retain v2
    LOS-9040            HM-21777                 J-0I4 / funded                                   $275,000; malformed ID, no roster match
    LOS-9122            HM-21902                 J-018 / Funded                                   $410,000; shared credit 60% / 40% with J-021
    LOS-9200            HM-22011                 J-022 / Test                                     $0; exclude
    LOS-9204            HM-22012                 J-022 / Withdrawn                                $0; exclude
    LOS-9310            HM-22109                 J-019 / Funded then rescinded                    $225,000; final not funded
    LOS-9440            HM-22281                 J-017 / Funded                                   $350,000; refund posted 02 Jul, bridge to Q2 loan
    RP-25-07            HM-21404                 J-011 / disputed repurchase                      ($210,000); rare, can reverse result

Controls expected: normalize statuses to a controlled set; deduplicate by stable loan key and final valid version; retain source-row lineage; route
malformed IDs to reconciliation/unassigned; shared-credit allocations sum to no more than 100%; attach post-close adjustments to the loan and
economic period.
 6. Applicable compensation-policy extracts (supplied text)
Restriction. A loan originator’s compensation may not be based on the terms or conditions of a loan, including interest rate, rate spread, loan amount,
or a proxy for those terms or conditions. This extract is limited to the stated jurisdiction and policy reach.
Unforeseen settlement-cost exception. A documented, unforeseen settlement cost may be charged only when (i) not reasonably foreseeable when
the arrangement was set, (ii) tied to a specific transaction, (iii) supported by contemporaneous records, and (iv) reviewed and approved under the
company’s documented process. The exception is narrow and does not authorize general true-ups.
The extract does not authorize charging hedge losses, routine reserve expense, actual repurchases, ordinary errors, or overall unprofitability back to
an officer. Profitability analysis may inform design work but does not establish that a formula, reduction, or January agreement complies. No
conclusion is broader than the supplied policy and jurisdiction.
7. Required review questions
    Question                                 Required answer / gate
    Decision objective                       Jarek selects branch closure, compensation restructuring, or a documented two-track analysis; each uses different
                                             primary evidence.
    Hedge evidence                           Tom Baird provides supportable loan allocation and tie-out to lock-desk totals, or the loan-level metric is
                                             unavailable/provisional.
    Repurchase dispute                       Priya Sen supplies case file and attribution; Ana Hutchins/counsel confirms treatment before compensation use.
    Period bridge                            Mina Rao documents migration/status mapping and Lena Ortiz documents April transfer/FTE bridge.
 8. Prior-draft revision checklist
    Defect in prior draft                        Required revision in final brief
    Undefined “profitable officer” list          Frame question around selected management decision; no universal ranking.
    Contribution treated as full profitability   Present three distinct definitions; contribution excludes corporate overhead and is not enterprise net profit.
    Assumed hedge allocation                     Condition loan-level net metric on supportable allocation; no invented equal/volume split.
    No exceptional-case treatment                Show recurring economics and all-in sensitivity with disputed repurchase separately identified.
    No population controls                       Use unique funded/closed-and-funded loans; exclude test, training, withdrawn, denied, cancelled and final
                                                 nonfunded records; bridge reversals.
    No policy boundary                           State supplied restriction and narrow exception; economic output is not compliance approval.
    No status decision                           Authorize common-core extract/reconciliation now; hold decision-dependent model build behind named gates.

9. Packet close-out note
The revised brief should be concise for a client principal and counsel to approve before January agreements. It should specify owners, dates, evidence
conditions, privacy limits, and whether each metric is authorized, conditional, provisional, or unavailable.

gold.note: DOCX 正文与表格单元格文字提取；不还原分页、字体与版式。
gold.text:
HARTSMERE SUPPLY
Revised Producer Profitability
Engagement Scope & Definitions Brief
For Jarek Ellingsen, Principal, and Ana Hutchins, Counsel  |  Foxhollow Press  |  15 July 2025
STATUS: OPERATIVE SCOPE. This is a scoping and definitions document—not a completed profitability model, legal opinion, or approval of any January producer agreement.
1. Decision question and boundaries
The work will determine officer economics for the management decision Jarek selects: (a) whether to restructure producer compensation, (b) whether to close the Boise branch, or (c) a documented two-track assessment. “Profitable officer” is not a universal answer. The selected decision changes the primary metric, interpretation, and data required.
The work will not issue one ranking that purports to answer both branch closure and compensation questions. It will produce separate metric views, bridges, exceptions, and decision support. This brief does not establish final officer profitability.
2. Revision record
Prior-draft issue / comment
Revision made
Undefined profitable-officer list; Boise and pay collapsed
Decision-specific question; branch closure and compensation restructuring are separate; sponsor selects or approves two tracks.
Contribution treated as profitability
Three definitions with uses and limits; contribution excludes corporate overhead and is not enterprise net profit.
Lock allocation assumed available
Loan-level metric conditional on supportable allocation and tie-out; no fabricated allocation.
Material repurchase hidden
Recurring and all-in views show disputed case separately; never spread or normalized.
No population/data controls
Funded population, final-status, deduplication lineage, ID/status exceptions, shared credit, reversals, privacy and owners specified.
Policy over-implied
Supplied restriction and narrow unforeseen-settlement-cost exception stated; economics is not compliance approval.
3. Three defensible readings (report separately)
Definition / formula
Decision use and boundary
Contribution before corporate overhead = funded-loan revenue attributable to officer − direct officer compensation (base/commission/bonus and directly attributable employer costs) − directly attributable production expense (processing/underwriting, transaction/vendor and other identified direct costs). Corporate overhead is excluded.
Incremental/branch economics. Not enterprise net profit; fixed/allocated costs may remain after exit. Not an automatic compensation formula.
Loan-level net economics = contribution components + supportably attributable lock-desk hedge gain/(loss) − repurchase-reserve / expected-loss charge. Actual repurchase losses and recoveries are separately identified, not substituted for routine reserve expense.
Economic analysis that may inform compensation design only after evidence/counsel review. If hedge allocation cannot be supported and reconciled to desk totals, metric is unavailable or provisional—not exact per-loan profit.
Capacity economics = capacity-cost numerator ÷ period-adjusted producing FTE. FTE derives from roster/payroll employment and transfer dates, paid-time/FTE, leave and producing-time evidence; headcount is not automatically FTE.
Staffing, deployment and branch-capacity decisions. Paid nonproducing time remains in denominator. Capacity cost is not individual loan/officer profit and is not a direct compensation basis.
Output control: publish three readings separately with a sponsor-selected primary metric. Never silently blend them into one officer score.
4. Period comparison basis
Compare Period A (1 Jan–31 Mar 2025, Q1) with Period B (1 Apr–30 Jun 2025, Q2), assigned by funded or settlement date—not application creation date. Use the same population, controlled status, ownership/credit rule and metric definitions unless a documented bridge is approved.
Packet summary
Q1 2025
Q2 2025
Interpretation
Funded loans / volume
418 / $112.4m
463 / $128.7m
+10.8% loans; +14.5% volume
Revenue / direct costs
$1.742m / $0.286m
$1.963m / $0.311m
Revenue +12.7%; direct cost +8.7%
Compensation / routine reserve
$0.842m / $0.091m
$0.904m / $0.104m
Comp +7.4%; reserve +14.3%
Hedge / disputed repurchase
($0.118m); $0.210m disputed in $0.228m total
($0.076m); $0.032m total
Hedge less negative; disputed case can reverse result
Producing FTE
29.5
31.0
+1.5 (+5.1%); April transfer bridge needed
Materiality: flag changes ≥10% or ≥$25,000, plus smaller decision-critical changes (repurchase or population/definition break). Explain volume, revenue/margin, direct cost, hedge, reserve/repurchase and capacity drivers without claiming causation. Migration/status mapping, April staffing transfer and accounting discontinuity require a bridge.
5. Authorized population and controls
Base population is one unique economic loan whose final valid status is funded or closed-and-funded and whose funded/settlement date falls in Q1 or Q2; exclude application-only records.
Exclude test/training, withdrawn, denied, cancelled and other nonfunded records. A later reversal/rescission/post-funding cancellation remains only if final economic status is funded; otherwise show it in a bridge.
Normalize inconsistent status spelling/case to a controlled analytical set before inclusion decisions.
Deduplicate migration rows by stable loan/business key plus version/update and final-status rule; retain retained/excluded source-row IDs in an audit lineage log.
Malformed/missing officer IDs go to reconciliation; unresolved identity is an unassigned bucket or quantified exclusion, never attribution to a likely officer.
Shared/transferred credit uses explicit percentages/role rule summing to no more than loan total. Refunds, reversals, pricing corrections and post-close adjustments attach to the loan and economic period or a documented bridge.
6. Data pull and model-build authorization
Status / owner
Authorized action and evidence condition
NOW — Mina Rao / Data Ops
Authorize common-core extraction/reconciliation: stable loan key/source row/version; funded and settlement dates; branch/officer; status; funded amount; revenue/margin; shared credit; adjustments. Apply privacy filter before transfer.
CONDITIONAL — Lena Ortiz / Payroll + Jarek
Pull compensation and direct production-cost fields; roster/employment/transfer dates; paid hours/FTE, leave, producing status/time, branch and capacity costs. Confirm close and April bridge.
HOLD — Tom Baird / Lock Desk
Loan-level metric waits for hedge amounts, allocation keys/method, lock IDs and Q1/Q2 control totals to reconcile. Aggregate desk result may be shown separately; never invent equal/volume splits.
HOLD — Priya Sen + Ana Hutchins
Repurchase treatment waits for case file, disputed status, claim, reserve/release, recovery and attribution; counsel sign-off before compensation use.
GATE — Jarek Ellingsen
Select branch closure vs compensation restructuring (or approve two-track). Publish decision-dependent rankings only after selection and evidence gates.
Sources and timing: LOS/Data Ops as of 30 Jun 2025 with migration history; payroll/roster at Q1/Q2 close; lock-desk final P&L and allocation support due 8 Aug; reserve/repurchase ledger through 30 Jun. Extraction approval does not authorize a blocked metric.
7. Exceptions, privacy and compliance boundary
Disputed repurchase RP-25-07 / loan key HM-21404 is rare and individually material; inclusion can reverse an officer result. Report recurring operating economics excluding the disputed actual loss and an all-in view including it, with amount visible. Do not normalize, spread across unrelated loans/officers, or treat it as routine reserve. Priya Sen owns evidence; Ana Hutchins/counsel reviews before compensation use, before January issuance.
Request only stable synthetic loan keys and necessary economics. Exclude borrower names, contacts, addresses, government identifiers, income, credit data and other unnecessary sensitive fields.
Supplied policy: compensation may not be based on loan terms or conditions, including interest rate, rate spread, loan amount or a proxy. The unforeseen settlement-cost exception applies only to a documented, transaction-specific cost not reasonably foreseeable when the arrangement was set, supported by contemporaneous records, and reviewed/approved under documented process. It is not authority to charge hedge losses, reserves, repurchases, ordinary errors or overall unprofitability to an officer. Profitability analysis alone does not prove a formula or reduction compliant. Conclusions are limited to supplied policy/jurisdiction; no broader clearance is claimed.
8. Deliverables and close-out status
Reconciled common-core population and exception log: duplicate lineage, unassigned IDs, status map, shared-credit control and adjustment bridge.
Separate contribution, hedge-and-reserve loan economics (if unblocked), and producing-FTE capacity views for Q1/Q2, with driver bridge and materiality flags.
Recurring-versus-all-in repurchase sensitivity and decision memo keyed to Jarek’s selected objective; no final compensation approval.
CURRENT DECISION: common-core pull and reconciliation are AUTHORIZED NOW. Metric-specific model construction is CONDITIONAL/HOLD as stated. Scope closes when Jarek selects the track, Tom supplies supportable hedge evidence (or the metric is labeled unavailable/provisional), and Priya/Ana resolve the disputed repurchase for decision use.

criteria.description: 所需的 DOCX 存在于顶层，文件名为 `producer_profitability_scope_brief.docx`，并作为有效的 Word 文档打开。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认准确的区分大小写的文件名、顶级位置以及可以打开或解析 DOCX。

original.criterion: The required DOCX exists at the top level under the exact filename `producer_profitability_scope_brief.docx` and opens as a valid Word document.
original.evidence: Submitted working directory and DOCX package.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the exact case-sensitive filename, top-level location, and that the DOCX can be opened or parsed.

criteria.description: 呈现的摘要不超过六页。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用标准办公套件进行渲染并计算所有页面，包括任何修订记录或附录。

original.criterion: The rendered brief is no longer than six pages.
original.grader_hint: Render using a standard office suite and count all pages, including any revision record or appendix.

criteria.description: 该文件清晰且经过专业组织，可供客户委托人和法律顾问审阅。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估标题、表格、间距和信息密度是否支持快速审阅，无需细小的文本、剪辑或无法解释的符号。

original.criterion: The document is legible and professionally organized for review by a client principal and legal counsel.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether headings, tables, spacing, and information density support rapid review without tiny text, clipping, or unexplained notation.

criteria.description: 该简报将其自身定位为修订后的业务范围和定义文件，而不是完整的盈利模型或法律意见书。
criteria.evidence: 标题、目的陈述或开头文字。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的范围/定义特征，并确认文档不会将其自身呈现为最终模型输出。

original.criterion: The brief identifies itself as the revised engagement scope and definitions document rather than as a completed profitability model or legal opinion.
original.evidence: Title, purpose statement, or opening text.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit scope/definitions characterization and confirm the document does not present itself as final model output.

criteria.description: 修订记录或等效摘要标识了针对数据包的评论和更改的事实所做的实质性更改。
criteria.evidence: 修订说明、变更摘要或综合响应声明。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当文件确定了实质性修订（例如决策模糊性、期间处理、政策边界、特殊回购处理或对冲数据可用性）时才予以认可，而不仅仅是新的日期或版本号。

original.criterion: The revision record or equivalent summary identifies the substantive changes made in response to the packet’s comments and changed facts.
original.evidence: Revision note, change summary, or integrated response statements.
original.grader_hint: Credit only if the document identifies substantive revisions such as decision ambiguity, period treatment, policy boundaries, exceptional repurchase treatment, or hedge-data availability—not merely a new date or version number.

criteria.description: 主要问题是确定特定管理决策的官员经济效益，而不是找到一个未定义的盈利官员的通用列表。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找将分析与决策背景联系起来的措辞，并拒绝“盈利”的无条件普遍含义。

original.criterion: The primary question is framed as determining officer economics for a specified management decision, not as finding an undefined universal list of profitable officers.
original.grader_hint: Look for wording that connects the analysis to a decision context and rejects an unqualified universal meaning of profitable.

criteria.description: 该简报分别将关闭分支机构和生产者薪酬重组确定为不同的可能决策。
criteria.evidence: 决策背景、范围或开放式问题内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 这两项决定都必须明确命名或明确描述，并且不得将它们分解为单一目标。

original.criterion: The brief separately identifies branch closure and producer-compensation restructuring as distinct possible decisions.
original.evidence: Decision context, scope, or open-questions content.
original.grader_hint: Both decisions must be expressly named or unmistakably described, and they must not be collapsed into a single objective.

criteria.description: 该文件明确指出，申办者未解决的决策目标会影响适当的指标、解释和数据要求。
criteria.grader_hint: 当依赖关系在操作上明确时给予信用；仅仅说需要更多信息是不够的。

original.criterion: The document makes clear that the sponsor’s unresolved decision objective affects the appropriate metric, interpretation, and data requirements.
original.grader_hint: Credit when the dependency is operationally clear; merely saying that more information is needed is insufficient.

criteria.description: 该范围并不保证某一官员级别能够同时回答分支机构和薪酬问题。
criteria.evidence: 范围边界、限制或定义比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找一个明确的界限，反对将一个排名或指标视为适合两个决策而不加限定。

original.criterion: The scope does not promise that one officer ranking will answer both the branch and compensation questions.
original.evidence: Scope boundary, limitations, or definition comparison.
original.grader_hint: Look for an express boundary against treating one ranking or metric as fit for both decisions without qualification.

criteria.description: 预期产出被定义为分析产品和决策支持，但没有声称范围界定简报本身确定了最终官员的盈利能力。
criteria.evidence: 可交付成果、输出和限制语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 简报应该说明后续模型将产生什么，同时将未来的结果与当前范围区分开来。

original.criterion: The intended outputs are defined as analysis products and decision support, without claiming that the scoping brief itself establishes final officer profitability.
original.grader_hint: The brief should say what the later model will produce while distinguishing those future results from the current scope.

criteria.description: 贡献盈利能力是使用可归因于军官级别的融资贷款收入或其他直接归因于生产成本来定义的。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认收入基础和直接成本扣除均存在。

original.criterion: Contribution profitability is defined using funded-loan revenue attributable to the officer less officer-level or otherwise directly attributable production costs.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that both the revenue basis and direct-cost deduction are present.

criteria.description: 贡献定义确定了数据包中可用的相关直接补偿和直接生产费用类别。
criteria.grader_hint: 将简报中所述的类别与数据包的数据清单进行比较；合理分组是可以的，但重要的直接类别不得省略。

original.criterion: The contribution definition identifies the relevant direct compensation and direct production-expense categories available in the packet.
original.grader_hint: Compare the categories stated in the brief with the packet’s data inventory; reasonable grouping is acceptable, but material direct categories may not be omitted.

criteria.description: 公司管理费用明确排除在缴款衡量标准之外。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的排除，而不仅仅是没有架空线路。

original.criterion: Corporate overhead is expressly excluded from the contribution measure.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit exclusion, not merely the absence of an overhead line.

criteria.description: 简报指出，企业管理费用前的贡献并不等于企业净利润。
criteria.evidence: 贡献定义附加的解释或限制。
criteria.grader_hint: 谨记明确警告，不要将贡献结果标记为全公司净利润或 GAAP 净利润。

original.criterion: The brief states that contribution before corporate overhead is not equivalent to enterprise net profit.
original.evidence: Interpretation or limitation attached to the contribution definition.
original.grader_hint: Credit an express warning against labeling the contribution result as full-company or GAAP net profit.

criteria.description: 贡献措施与适当的增量或部门经济使用相关，并明确了固定成本限制。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估拟议的用途是否认识到避免设立分支机构或高级职员并不会自动消除所有分配或固定成本。

original.criterion: The contribution measure is linked to an appropriate incremental or branch-economics use, with fixed-cost limitations made clear.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether the proposed use recognizes that avoiding a branch or officer does not automatically eliminate every allocated or fixed cost.

criteria.description: 贷款层面的净利润定义包括可归因的锁台对冲效应。
criteria.evidence: 贷款级净利润公式或定义。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找对冲收益/损失、锁台盈亏或等效数据包术语作为指标的一部分。

original.criterion: The loan-level net-profit definition includes attributable lock-desk hedging effects.
original.grader_hint: Look for hedge gain/loss, lock-desk P&L, or equivalent packet terminology as part of the metric.

criteria.description: 贷款层面的净利润定义包括适用的回购准备金费用或预期损失部分。
criteria.evidence: 贷款级净利润公式或定义。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认包括准备金处理，并将其与仅计算资助量区分开来。

original.criterion: The loan-level net-profit definition includes the applicable repurchase-reserve charge or expected-loss component.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that reserve treatment is included and distinguished from merely counting funded volume.

criteria.description: 在定义中，实际回购损失与日常准备金支出是有区别的。
criteria.evidence: 定义、异常处理或公式注释。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当实际实现的回购损失和模拟或记入准备金被视为不同概念时才信用。

original.criterion: Actual repurchase losses are distinguished from routine reserve expense in the definition set.
original.evidence: Definitions, exception treatment, or formula notes.
original.grader_hint: Credit only when actual realized repurchase loss and modeled or booked reserve are treated as different concepts.

criteria.description: 贷款层面净利润指标的可行性明确取决于获得可支持的贷款层面对冲分配或可追踪的等价物。
criteria.evidence: 数据依赖性和指标状态。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认当不满足数据包规定的分配依赖性时，定义的可用性会发生变化。

original.criterion: The feasibility of the loan-level net-profit metric is explicitly conditional on obtaining a supportable loan-level hedge allocation or traceable equivalent.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that the definition’s availability changes when the packet’s stated allocation dependency is not met.

criteria.description: 该简报并未将缺乏可支持的对冲分配的估计描述为确切的每笔贷款利润。
criteria.grader_hint: 当分配证据不可用时，寻找针对准确性、完整性或审计精度的明确限定。

original.criterion: The brief does not characterize an estimate lacking supportable hedge allocation as exact per-loan profit.
original.grader_hint: Look for an express qualification against exactness, completeness, or audited precision when allocation evidence is unavailable.

criteria.description: 贷款水平净衡量指标被描述为可以为补偿设计提供信息的经济分析，而不是作为补偿安排符合政策的证据。
criteria.grader_hint: 当经济性和薪酬合规性明确分开时，信用。

original.criterion: The loan-level net measure is described as economic analysis that may inform compensation design, not as proof that a compensation arrangement complies with policy.
original.grader_hint: Credit when economics and compensation compliance are clearly separated.

criteria.description: 产能经济学是用成本衡量指标除以生产 FTE 或等效的生产能力分母来定义的。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认该指标既有成本分子又有生产能力分母。

original.criterion: Capacity economics is defined using a cost measure divided by producing FTE or an equivalent productive-capacity denominator.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that the measure has both a cost numerator and a producing-capacity denominator.

criteria.description: 该简报定义了如何从可用的花名册、工资单或生产时间证据中得出 FTE 的产生，而不是将员工总数自动等于 FTE。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找对部分期间、休假、兼职状态、调动或与 FTE 相关的同等因素的处理。

original.criterion: The brief defines how producing FTE is derived from the available roster, payroll, or productive-time evidence rather than treating headcount as automatically equal to FTE.
original.grader_hint: Look for treatment of partial periods, leave, part-time status, transfers, or equivalent factors relevant to FTE.

criteria.description: 产能衡量指标以符合其规定的人员配置目的的方式考虑非生产时间或未使用的产能。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估该文件是否避免了默默忽略有偿但非生产能力的分母。

original.criterion: The capacity measure accounts for nonproducing time or unused capacity in a way that is consistent with its stated staffing purpose.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether the document avoids a denominator that silently ignores paid but nonproducing capacity.

criteria.description: 该文件指出，能力成本与个人贷款或个人官员赚取的利润不同。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找与贷款级别或官员级别利润的明确区别。

original.criterion: The document states that capacity cost is not the same as profit earned on an individual loan or by an individual officer.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit distinction from loan-level or officer-level profit.

criteria.description: 能力经济学与人员配置或分支机构能力决策相关，而不是作为改变官员薪酬的直接基础。
criteria.grader_hint: 当使用仅限于容量部署、人员配备或分支机构经济状况且不作为补偿公式时，即为信用。

original.criterion: Capacity economics is connected to staffing or branch-capacity decisions rather than presented as a direct basis for changing an officer’s compensation.
original.grader_hint: Credit when the use is bounded to capacity deployment, staffing, or branch economics and not asserted as a compensation formula.

criteria.description: 所有三个盈利能力读数均以不同的定义呈现，具有明显不同的组成部分和决策用途。
criteria.grader_hint: 审查者应该能够区分贡献、对冲和准备金调整后的贷款经济学以及生产 FTE 能力经济学，而无需进行推理。

original.criterion: All three profitability readings are presented as distinct definitions with visibly different components and decision uses.
original.grader_hint: A reviewer should be able to distinguish contribution, hedge-and-reserve-adjusted loan economics, and producing-FTE capacity economics without inference.

criteria.description: 该简报防止这三个定义被悄悄地混合到一个综合军官排名中。
criteria.evidence: 输出设计、范围边界或定义比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找单独的报告、发起人选择的主要指标或针对无法解释的混合分数的其他明确控制。

original.criterion: The brief prevents the three definitions from being silently blended into one composite officer ranking.
original.evidence: Output design, scope boundary, or definition comparison.
original.grader_hint: Look for separate reporting, a sponsor-selected primary metric, or another explicit control against an unexplained blended score.

criteria.description: 比较周期与源数据包中指定的两个分析周期完全匹配。
criteria.grader_hint: 将规定的开始和结束日期或季度标签与数据包的指定比较期进行比较。

original.criterion: The comparison periods exactly match the two analysis periods designated in the source packet.
original.grader_hint: Compare the stated start and end dates or quarter labels to the packet’s designated comparison periods.

criteria.description: 除非提供记录的桥梁，否则期间比较需要两个时期内一致的人口、状态、所有权和指标定义。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认群体或定义的变化不能被误认为是经济变化。

original.criterion: The period comparison requires consistent population, status, ownership, and metric definitions across both periods unless a documented bridge is provided.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that changes in cohort or definitions cannot be mistaken for economic change.

criteria.description: 该简报准确地识别了数据包中已经证明的重大期间变化，而没有提出不受支持的因果结论。
criteria.grader_hint: 将规定的方向或数字变化与数据包进行比较。信用事实描述；如果相关性被声明为已证明的因果关系，则保留。

original.criterion: The brief accurately identifies the material period-over-period changes already evidenced in the packet without presenting unsupported causal conclusions.
original.grader_hint: Compare stated directional or numeric changes with the packet. Credit factual characterization; withhold if correlation is stated as proven causation.

criteria.description: 该简报定义了一个重要性惯例，用于使用幅度和业务相关性来突出显示期间变化，而不是将每个差异报告为重大差异。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受明确的定量阈值、双重绝对/百分比约定或记录的关键决策变更例外情况。

original.criterion: The brief defines a materiality convention for highlighting period changes using both magnitude and business relevance, rather than reporting every variance as material.
original.grader_hint: Accept a clear quantitative threshold, a dual absolute/percentage convention, or a documented exception for decision-critical changes.

criteria.description: 计划的比较需要解释重要的驱动因素，包括数量、收入或利润、直接成本、对冲或储备效应以及适用的产能。
criteria.grader_hint: 驱动程序集应遵循选定的指标，并足以解释变化，而不是简单地显示两个总计。

original.criterion: The planned comparison calls for explanation of significant drivers, including volume, revenue or margin, direct cost, hedge or reserve effects, and capacity where applicable.
original.grader_hint: The driver set should follow the selected metric and be sufficient to explain change rather than simply display two totals.

criteria.description: 数据可用性、系统迁移、人员配备或会计处理方面的已知变化被识别为可比性限制或过渡项目。
criteria.evidence: 期限限制和事实变化的响应。
criteria.grader_hint: 与数据包的更改事实部分进行比较，并确认相关的不连续性没有被遗漏。

original.criterion: Known changes in data availability, system migration, staffing, or accounting treatment are identified as comparability limitations or bridge items.
original.grader_hint: Compare with the packet’s changed-facts section and confirm that relevant discontinuities are not omitted.

criteria.description: 基础贷款人口取决于资助或封闭资助的生产，而不是所有申请记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找与数据包字段一致的资助事件标准。

original.criterion: The base loan population is anchored to funded or closed-and-funded production rather than all application records.
original.grader_hint: Look for a funded-event criterion consistent with the packet’s fields.

criteria.description: 数据包中标识的测试、培训、撤回、拒绝、取消和其他非资助或不相关记录均不包括在资助生产结果中。
criteria.grader_hint: 合理的分组是可以接受的，但是定义必须去除数据包的不相关的状态族和测试记录。

original.criterion: Test, training, withdrawn, denied, cancelled, and other nonfunded or irrelevant records identified in the packet are excluded from funded-production results.
original.grader_hint: Reasonable grouping is acceptable, but the definition must remove the packet’s irrelevant status families and test records.

criteria.description: 该简报详细说明了如何处理撤销、撤销或资助后取消，而不是假设所有标记为资助的记录仍然包括在内。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找与最终经济状况或资助后变更的调节流程相关的规则。

original.criterion: The brief specifies how reversals, rescissions, or post-funding cancellations are treated rather than assuming every record once marked funded remains included.
original.grader_hint: Look for a rule tied to final economic status or a reconciliation process for post-funding changes.

criteria.description: 期间分配使用数据包中确定的经济相关的资助或结算日期，而不是申请创建日期。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认所选日期字段与数据包的资助生产基础一致。

original.criterion: Period assignment uses the economically relevant funded or settlement date identified in the packet, not application creation date.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that the selected date field agrees with the packet’s funded-production basis.

criteria.description: 使用稳定贷款或企业标识符加上可辩护的版本或最终状态规则，重复迁移可减少为一笔经济贷款。
criteria.grader_hint: 留存人口不得计算同一经济贷款的多个迁移版本；该规则应保留当前有效记录并可重现。

original.criterion: Migration duplicates are reduced to one economic loan using a stable loan or business identifier plus a defensible version or final-status rule.
original.grader_hint: The retained population must not count multiple migrated versions of the same economic loan; the rule should preserve the current valid record and be reproducible.

criteria.description: 重复数据删除规范在排除的重复记录和保留的经济贷款之间保留审计线索。
criteria.grader_hint: 查找源记录沿袭、保留/排除的标识符或异常日志，而不是无痕迹的破坏性删除。

original.criterion: The deduplication specification preserves an audit trail between excluded duplicate records and the retained economic loan.
original.grader_hint: Look for source-record lineage, retained/excluded identifiers, or an exception log rather than destructive deletion without trace.

criteria.description: 格式错误或缺失的官员标识符将被发送到例外或协调流程，而不是自动归因。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认未经验证的 ID 不会直接流入官员的结果中。

original.criterion: Malformed or missing officer identifiers are routed to an exception or reconciliation process instead of being automatically attributed.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that unvalidated IDs do not flow directly into officer results.

criteria.description: 在应用包含和排除决策之前，不一致的源状态标签会映射到受控分析状态集。
criteria.grader_hint: 查找覆盖数据包中显示的不一致标签的映射或规范化。

original.criterion: Inconsistent source status labels are mapped to a controlled analytical status set before inclusion and exclusion decisions are applied.
original.grader_hint: Look for mapping or normalization that covers the inconsistent labels shown in the packet.

criteria.description: 无法解析官员身份的记录将报告为未分配或排除，并具有量化影响，而不是强加给可能的官员。
criteria.grader_hint: 信用透明的未分配存储桶或排除桥，显示计数或财务影响。

original.criterion: Records whose officer identity cannot be resolved are reported as unassigned or excluded with quantified impact, not forced onto a likely officer.
original.grader_hint: Credit a transparent unassigned bucket or exclusion bridge that shows count or financial impact.

criteria.description: 共享或转让生产信贷的贷款有明确的分配规则，防止官员信贷总额超过贷款的信贷总额。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找分配的百分比、基于角色的归因或其他控制规则，其分配总和等于可用总数。

original.criterion: Loans with shared or transferred production credit have an explicit allocation rule that prevents total officer credit from exceeding the loan’s total credit.
original.grader_hint: Look for split-credit percentages, role-based attribution, or another controlled rule whose allocations sum to the available total.

criteria.description: 退款、冲销、定价更正和其他交割后调整均分配给相关贷款和期间，或显示在记录的桥梁中。
criteria.grader_hint: 该规范必须避免仅仅因为调整发布日期而放弃调整或将其附加给官员。

original.criterion: Refunds, reversals, pricing corrections, and other post-close adjustments are assigned to the relevant loan and period or shown in a documented bridge.
original.grader_hint: The specification must avoid dropping adjustments or attaching them to an officer solely because of the adjustment posting date.

criteria.description: 共同核心数据拉取包括确定人口和协调结果所需的标识符、日期、分支机构和官员归属、状态、资助金额和收入字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 与包裹的库存进行比较。当功能等效字段和分组字段描述支持可追溯性时，应予以信用。

original.criterion: The common-core data pull includes the identifiers, dates, branch and officer attribution, status, funded amount, and revenue fields needed to establish the population and reconcile results.
original.grader_hint: Compare with the packet’s inventory. Credit functionally equivalent fields and grouped field descriptions when they support traceability.

criteria.description: 贡献数据拉动包括可用的官员薪酬和规定公式所需的直接归属生产成本字段。
criteria.evidence: 特定于指标的数据要求。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据数据包检查公式到字段的完整性；包含成本成分的每个材料都应具有源字段或规定的派生。

original.criterion: The contribution data pull includes the available officer compensation and directly attributable production-cost fields needed by the stated formula.
original.grader_hint: Check formula-to-field completeness against the packet; every material included cost component should have a source field or stated derivation.

criteria.description: 贷款层面的净利润拉动要求对冲分配输入、分配密钥和调节总额足以将贷款层面的金额追溯到锁台总额。
criteria.grader_hint: 当拉动同时支持分配和捆绑时信用；请求单一的无法解释的对冲金额是不够的。

original.criterion: The loan-level net-profit pull requests hedge allocation inputs, allocation keys, and reconciliation totals sufficient to trace loan-level amounts back to lock-desk totals.
original.grader_hint: Credit when the pull supports both allocation and tie-out; a request for a single unexplained hedge amount is insufficient.

criteria.description: 储备和回购数据要求区分储备率或费用、储备释放、实际索赔、追偿以及数据包中存在这些字段的情况状态。
criteria.grader_hint: 该规范必须允许将常规预期损失费用与实际异常损失和后续恢复分开。

original.criterion: Reserve and repurchase data requirements distinguish reserve rates or charges, reserve releases, actual claims, recoveries, and case status where those fields exist in the packet.
original.grader_hint: The specification must permit routine expected-loss expense to be separated from actual exceptional losses and subsequent recoveries.

criteria.description: 产能数据拉动包括名册或就业日期、带薪时间或 FTE 证据、生产状态、分支机构分配和相关产能成本。
criteria.grader_hint: 与数据包库存进行比较，并确认所请求的数据可以支持特定时期的生产 FTE，而不是简单的期末员工人数。

original.criterion: The capacity data pull includes roster or employment dates, paid-time or FTE evidence, producing status, branch assignment, and relevant capacity costs.
original.grader_hint: Compare with the packet inventory and confirm the requested data can support period-specific producing FTE rather than simple ending headcount.

criteria.description: 每个材料数据域都有一个源系统或证据源、负责的所有者以及当前或提取时间要求。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果所有权和时间安排明确，则接受合并的源矩阵或等效散文。

original.criterion: Each material data domain has a source system or evidence source, responsible owner, and as-of or extraction timing requirement.
original.grader_hint: Accept a consolidated source matrix or equivalent prose if ownership and timing are unambiguous.

criteria.description: 请求和复制的数据仅限于分析需要的数据，并省略借款人姓名、联系信息、政府标识符和其他不必要的借款人敏感内容。
criteria.evidence: 数据拉取规范以及摘要中的所有示例或表格。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果简介使用贷款密钥或汇总示例并明确排除不必要的借款人 PII，则表示信用；检查完整文档中是否有复制的敏感样本值。

original.criterion: The requested and reproduced data are limited to what the analysis needs and omit borrower names, contact information, government identifiers, and other unnecessary borrower-sensitive content.
original.evidence: Data-pull specification and all examples or tables in the brief.
original.grader_hint: Credit if the brief uses loan keys or aggregated examples and expressly excludes unnecessary borrower PII; inspect the full document for copied sensitive sample values.

criteria.description: 有争议的回购被认为是罕见的、个别重大的例外情况，其处理可能会推翻官员的结果。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻求对稀有性和潜在排名影响的明确认识；通用保留语言是不够的。

original.criterion: The disputed repurchase is identified as a rare, individually material exception whose treatment can reverse an officer result.
original.grader_hint: Look for explicit recognition of both rarity and potential ranking impact; generic reserve language is insufficient.

criteria.description: 计划产出将经常性运营经济学与包括有争议的回购在内的整体观点区分开来，或提供同等透明的敏感性表述。
criteria.grader_hint: 相信双重观点或敏感性，可以让审阅者看到有争议案件和没有争议案件的结果，同时保留基本金额。

original.criterion: The planned output separates recurring operating economics from an all-in view that includes the disputed repurchase, or provides an equivalently transparent sensitivity presentation.
original.grader_hint: Credit a dual view or sensitivity that lets reviewers see the result with and without the disputed case while preserving the underlying amount.

criteria.description: 特殊回购并没有悄然正常化，分散到不相关的贷款或官员中，也没有被视为常规储备经验。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻求明确的禁止或明显保留特定病例效果的治疗方法。

original.criterion: The exceptional repurchase is not silently normalized, spread across unrelated loans or officers, or treated as routine reserve experience.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit prohibition or a treatment that clearly preserves the case-specific effect.

criteria.description: 该简报将未解决的回购归属或争议状态分配给适当的证据所有者或律师进行审查，然后再用于赔偿行动。
criteria.evidence: 异常升级和决策使用控制。

original.criterion: The brief assigns unresolved repurchase attribution or dispute status to an appropriate evidence owner or counsel review before it is used for compensation action.

criteria.description: 该简报指出，如果锁台仅提供汇总结果而没有可支持的分配基础，则贷款水平对冲调整指标无法按规定完成。

original.criterion: The brief states that the loan-level hedge-adjusted metric cannot be completed as specified if the lock desk supplies only aggregate results without a supportable allocation basis.

criteria.grader_hint: 贷记分行级别的演示文稿、不可用的指定、单独的未分配金额或其他透明的后备方案；如果不受支持的分配按实际情况呈现，则扣留。

original.criterion: The fallback for unavailable loan-level hedge data avoids inventing equal, volume-based, or other unsupported allocations.
original.grader_hint: Credit a branch-level presentation, unavailable designation, separate unallocated amount, or another transparent fallback; withhold if an unsupported allocation is presented as actual.

criteria.description: 当无法获得所需的对冲证据时，受影响的指标或结果将被标记为不可用、临时或有限。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找可见的状态，防止用户将不完整的指标视为最终指标。

original.criterion: The affected metric or result is labeled unavailable, provisional, or limited when the required hedge evidence cannot be obtained.
original.grader_hint: Look for a visible status that prevents users from treating the incomplete metric as final.

criteria.description: 不完整数据路径标识了负责的所有者、升级接收者、决策截止日期以及解锁指标的证据条件。
criteria.grader_hint: 所有四个要素都必须在操作上可识别，无论是在散文中还是在决策表中表述。

original.criterion: The incomplete-data path identifies an accountable owner, escalation recipient, decision deadline, and evidence condition for unblocking the metric.
original.grader_hint: All four elements must be operationally identifiable, whether stated in prose or a decision table.

criteria.description: 该简报准确地说明了所提供的政策限制，禁止根据贷款条款、条件或禁止的代理对贷款发起人进行补偿。
criteria.evidence: 合规性评估或政策约束。
criteria.grader_hint: 将语句与数据包的策略摘录进行比较。如果释义保留了范围并且不扩大或缩小规则，则可以接受。

original.criterion: The brief accurately states the supplied policy restriction against basing loan-originator compensation on loan terms, conditions, or prohibited proxies.
original.grader_hint: Compare the statement with the packet’s policy extract. Paraphrase is acceptable if it preserves the scope and does not broaden or narrow the rule.

criteria.description: 该文件指出，仅盈利能力分析并不能证明拟议的薪酬公式或削减是合规的。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找一个明确的禁止推论，将经济结果与法律或政策批准分开。

original.criterion: The document states that profitability analysis alone does not establish that a proposed compensation formula or reduction is compliant.
original.grader_hint: Look for an express must-not inference separating an economic result from legal or policy approval.

criteria.description: 对所提供的不可预见的结算成本例外的任何讨论都会保留数据包的规定条件、文档要求和狭窄的范围。
criteria.grader_hint: 与确切的政策摘录进行比较，并确认该例外情况没有概括得如此广泛，以至于其条件消失了。

original.criterion: Any discussion of the supplied unforeseen-settlement-cost exception preserves the packet’s stated conditions, documentation requirements, and narrow scope.
original.grader_hint: Compare with the exact policy extract and confirm that the exception is not summarized so broadly that its conditions disappear.

criteria.description: 该简报并未将不可预见的结算成本例外视为向官员收取对冲损失、准备金、回购、普通错误或整体无利可图的一般权力。
criteria.evidence: 附加到异常的合规边界。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找一个明确的限制，涵盖看似合理但不受支持的异常扩展。

original.criterion: The brief does not treat the unforeseen-settlement-cost exception as general authority to charge hedge losses, reserves, repurchases, ordinary errors, or overall unprofitability back to an officer.
original.evidence: Compliance boundary attached to the exception.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit limitation covering the plausible but unsupported extension of the exception.

criteria.description: 该简报通过为公共核心数据拉取和模型构建设定明确的当前状态来行使其授权，并将未解决的依赖于定义的工作作为有条件的而不是作为无主建议留下。
criteria.evidence: 授权、批准状态或范围控制声明。
criteria.grader_hint: 一个合理的结果是批准决策中立的源提取，同时将模型或特定于度量的工作等待命名条件。同等清晰、基于证据的状态决策可能会获得认可。

original.criterion: The brief exercises its delegated authority by setting a clear current status for the common-core data pull and the model build, with unresolved definition-dependent work made conditional rather than left as an ownerless suggestion.
original.evidence: Authorization, approval status, or scope-control statement.
original.grader_hint: A defensible result is approval of decision-neutral source extraction while holding the model or metric-specific work pending named conditions. Equivalent clear, evidence-based status decisions may receive credit.

criteria.description: 在受影响的模型工作继续进行之前，开放的决策和假设作为负责人的可回答项目、所需的响应以及批准或签核条件呈现。
criteria.evidence: 决策日志、假设登记册或批准条件。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认可以关闭未解决的问题，而无需询问作者需要什么答复或谁必须提供答复。

original.criterion: Open decisions and assumptions are presented as answerable items with an owner, required response, and approval or sign-off condition before affected model work proceeds.
original.evidence: Decision log, assumptions register, or approval conditions.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that unresolved matters can be closed without asking the author what response is needed or who must provide it.

criteria.description: 合规结论明确限于数据包中提供的政策文本和管辖范围，而不要求更广泛的监管许可。
criteria.evidence: 范围限制或合规免责声明。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的提供保单边界，并且不存在关于其他司法管辖区或全面法律合规性的不受支持的主张。

original.criterion: Compliance conclusions are expressly limited to the policy text and jurisdictional scope supplied in the packet, without claiming broader regulatory clearance.
original.grader_hint: Look for a clear supplied-policy boundary and absence of unsupported claims about other jurisdictions or comprehensive legal compliance.

criteria.description: 总的来说，该简报足够具体，数据所有者、模型构建者、客户委托人和律师都可以采取行动，而无需要求作者定义总体、公式、例外、批准或阻塞数据路径。
criteria.grader_hint: 查看所有部分后评估操作可用性。如果关键术语、职责、状态或决策门仍然不明确，仅靠技术正确性是不够的。

original.criterion: Taken as a whole, the brief is specific enough for the data owners, model builder, client principal, and counsel to act without asking the author to define the population, formulas, exceptions, approvals, or blocked-data path.
original.grader_hint: Evaluate operational usability after reviewing all sections. Technical correctness alone is insufficient if key terms, responsibilities, statuses, or decision gates remain ambiguous.

spec.professional_context: A financial manager is revising a client-facing scope before a producer-profitability model is built. The brief will be used by the client principal and legal counsel to control the data pull, analysis, and January agreement decision.
difficulty_sources: Distinguishing three defensible profitability definitions and mapping each to a different management decision
Revising a flawed draft against explicit comments and changed facts
Normalizing duplicated, malformed, irrelevant, and inconsistently labeled evidence
Comparing two periods without confusing data discontinuities with economic change
Applying only the supplied compensation-policy language while avoiding unsupported legal conclusions
Designing transparent handling for a rare material repurchase and an unavailable hedge-allocation path

reference_artifact.format: A single mixed-evidence PDF packet that is usable offline.
components: A prior draft scope that silently adopts contribution before corporate overhead, lacks a decision-use distinction, assumes hedge allocations will be available, and does not isolate a material repurchase.

Explicit review comments from the principal, counsel, and data owner requesting a clearer decision question, policy boundary, period comparison, data specification, revision status, and treatment of changed facts.

A changed-facts note establishing that the potential decision may be either branch closure or compensation restructuring, that loan-level hedge allocations may not be available, and that a disputed repurchase can reverse one officer’s apparent result.

Two completed-period summaries with enough figures to verify directional and percentage changes in funded count, volume, revenue or margin, direct costs, hedge results, reserve activity, and producing FTE.

A data inventory covering loan-system records, compensation and payroll data, lock-desk data, reserve and repurchase records, roster data, field owners, extraction timing, and field-level availability.

A compact set of synthetic sample records demonstrating migration duplicates, revised versions, malformed officer identifiers, inconsistent status labels, test or training records, nonfunded statuses, shared production credit, reversals, and post-close adjustments.

Applicable compensation-policy excerpts limited to the task’s supplied jurisdiction and policy reach, including the restriction on compensation based on loan terms or conditions and the narrow conditions for an unforeseen-settlement-cost adjustment.
A note identifying unnecessary borrower-sensitive fields present in operational systems so that a competent scope excludes them from the pull.

imperfections_required: At least one economic loan appears more than once because migration and later status versions coexist; duplicates must be identifiable through a stable business key and version or update evidence.
Some officer identifiers are malformed, missing, or inconsistent with the roster; at least one cannot be resolved from the packet and must remain unassigned or excluded transparently.
Statuses include inconsistent spelling or casing and semantically equivalent labels, alongside test, withdrawn, denied, cancelled, and funded records.
At least one loan has shared or transferred production credit, requiring allocations that do not exceed the available total.
At least one post-funding reversal, refund, or pricing correction falls in a different posting period from the underlying loan.
The two periods have a genuine material change in at least two operating drivers, while a system, staffing, or accounting discontinuity prevents naive like-for-like interpretation.
One disputed actual repurchase is rare and sufficiently large to reverse an officer-level result if included; routine reserve amounts and any recovery information must remain separately identifiable.
The lock-desk evidence contains aggregate results and a possible allocation key but does not guarantee a complete supportable loan-level allocation.
The prior draft contains claims and assumptions that the review comments require the solver to revise, rather than merely reformat.
gold_relationships: The base production population consists of unique economic loans whose final valid status meets the packet’s funded definition and whose relevant funded or settlement date falls within the applicable period.
Duplicate source rows do not create additional loan count, volume, revenue, or cost; retained and excluded source records remain traceable.
Officer-level shared credit sums to no more than the loan-level total available credit.
Contribution equals included funded-loan revenue less officer compensation and directly attributable production costs identified in the packet; corporate overhead is excluded.

Loan-level net economics equals the contribution components adjusted for supportably attributable hedge effects and reserve expense, with actual repurchase events and recoveries separately identified.
A loan-level hedge-adjusted result is not final or exact unless allocated amounts reconcile to the corresponding lock-desk control totals under a supported allocation basis.
Capacity economics uses the relevant capacity-cost numerator and period-adjusted producing-FTE denominator; ending headcount alone is not a sufficient denominator.
Period comparisons use consistent definitions and populations or explicitly bridge changes in system, status mapping, staffing, or accounting treatment.
The exceptional repurchase is visible in an all-in result and separately visible from recurring operating economics; it is never silently normalized or spread across unrelated production.

If required hedge evidence remains unavailable, the gold leaves the affected loan-level metric unavailable or provisional, preserves aggregate results separately, identifies an owner and deadline, and does not fabricate allocations.

The common-core pull may proceed because its identifiers, population fields, and reconciliation data are useful under all three definitions; model construction and decision-dependent fields remain conditional on sponsor and evidence gates.
Any numeric comparison in the gold is derived directly from the packet’s retained records or period summaries and agrees across prose, tables, and status statements.
doctrinal_boundaries: State the supplied restriction concerning compensation based on loan terms, conditions, or prohibited proxies, but do not claim that the profitability analysis itself proves compensation compliance.

State the narrow unforeseen-settlement-cost exception with all supplied conditions, but do not extend it to ordinary unprofitability, hedge losses, reserves, repurchases, general errors, or routine chargebacks.
Explain that economic measures may inform a compensation decision, but do not present a particular compensation change as approved by counsel.
Limit conclusions to the supplied policy and jurisdictional text; do not cite external law or claim comprehensive regulatory clearance.
Describe contribution before overhead accurately, but do not label it enterprise net profit.
Describe capacity economics as staffing or branch evidence, but do not label it individual loan profit.
authoring_plan.expected_authorized_action: The gold brief sets an operative engagement status rather than ending with a recommendation for someone else to set one. It authorizes extraction and reconciliation of the decision-neutral common-core data, holds model build or metric-specific conclusions behind named sponsor, counsel, and data-evidence conditions, and records what changed from the prior draft.
authoring_plan.sensitive_data_handling: The gold requests stable synthetic loan keys and necessary economic fields but excludes borrower names, contact details, government identifiers, addresses, and copied borrower-level examples. Any exception examples are referred to by non-sensitive case or loan keys.
authoring_plan.space_feasibility: The full set of required content can be expressed in six pages through concise definition, data-requirement, exception, and decision-status tables plus short explanatory text. The gold should not add external legal background, model output, or a detailed procedural appendix.

title_original: authored doc doctrinal producer profitability scope
original_instruction:
You are the financial manager at Foxhollow Press responsible for scoping the profitability work for Hartsmere Supply, a mortgage lender with 32 loan officers. Jarek Ellingsen wants to know which officers are actually profitable before January producer agreements are issued, but he has not said whether the decision is to restructure compensation or close the Boise branch. Those are not interchangeable: contribution before corporate overhead, loan-level profit after lock-desk hedging and repurchase reserve, and capacity cost per producing FTE could each produce a defensible but different answer. Ana Hutchins also needs the scope to stay within the compensation-policy language supplied for this engagement rather than imply that an economically attractive plan is legally approved. Revise the existing draft using `Hartsmere_scope_review_packet.pdf`, which contains the draft, review comments, changed facts, period summaries, data inventory, sample records, and applicable policy extracts. The source data has migration duplicates, malformed officer identifiers, inconsistent status labels, and records that do not belong in a funded-production analysis. It also shows one disputed repurchase large enough to reverse an officer’s apparent result, so the brief cannot bury that case inside routine guidance, and the lock desk may be unable to provide loan-level allocations needed for one of the proposed definitions. Produce a final engagement scoping and definitions brief for Jarek and Ana that states the question the work will and will not answer, distinguishes the defensible profitability definitions and their decision uses, specifies the comparison periods and data pull, addresses the review comments and changed facts, records the treatment or escalation of unresolved evidence, and sets the authorized data-pull and model-build status rather than merely suggesting what someone else should decide. Use only figures and policy language supported by the packet, minimize borrower-sensitive information, and keep the document to six pages maximum. Write the completed file into the top level of the working directory using exactly the filename `producer_profitability_scope_brief.docx`.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/Hartsmere_scope_review_packet.pdf` — Source packet containing the prior draft, explicit review comments, changed engagement facts, two-period operating summaries, data inventory and sample records, and the policy text applicable to the assessment.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `producer_profitability_scope_brief.docx` — Revised engagement scoping and definitions brief establishing the decision question, alternative profitability definitions, comparison basis, data requirements, compliance boundaries, exceptions, unresolved-data path, and authorized engagement status. (Place the file at the top level of the working directory.; Use exactly the specified filename.; Do not exceed six rendered pages.; Use only figures, facts, and policy language supported by the supplied packet.; Minimize borrower-sensitive information.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
